description: RETRY (2026-09-26, connection 3). Connections 1-2 (real; work/verify/results/harness-selftest-2026-09-26T{11-57-52-819Z,12-13-00-709Z}.json) found and fixed TWO independent, harness-wide bugs, both confirmed against primary sources and now fixed in verify/lib/{batch,clgen}.mjs (not just this manifest): (1) explicit setccsid+STMFCCSID broke CPYFRMSTMF (CPFA0A2/CPFA095) - fixed by making 'no CCSID handling' the harness-wide default; heredocWrite now also `rm -f`s the target path first so re-runs observe a genuinely fresh file's tag, not a stale one left over from an earlier connection's own setccsid (advisor caught this contamination in connection 2's own evidence: result.stderr showed 'mkdir: ... File exists', proving the directory/file were NOT fresh). (2) heredocWrite() appended an extra trailing blank line to every transferred file (content already ends in \n, then .join('\n') added another) - RPG III's compiler rejected T0ZERO's own trailing blank line as 'Form-Type entry invalid' (QRG2001), so T0ZERO never actually compiled in connection 2 despite the transfer itself succeeding. Also found (3) PUB400's QDECFMT uses a comma as the decimal point (cl_commands_75.txt:4583-4600 confirms: 'if QDECFMT specifies... a comma; any numeric constants in lists... must be separated by a comma followed by a blank') - clgen.mjs's own SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,1,200) in the VFYLOG-insert SQL hit exactly this (SQL0104 'Token ,1 was not valid'), fixed to SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT, 1, 200). This connection re-tests all three fixes together on a batch whose files/dir will genuinely be fresh (never transferred under the OLD code), and finally answers this manifest's ORIGINAL question (does INQMSGRPY(*DFT) auto-answer RPG0102?), which connections 1-2 never reached. debugCcsid stays on (now ls -S + od -x only, attr -p CCSID dropped - wrong syntax, connection 2 confirmed: 'attr: 001-2249 Attribute ... is not valid').
